name: Cody's Gastro Garage Slow-Smoked Pulled Pork or Plain Burger Sliders
brandOrRestaurant: Cody's Gastro Garage (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Smaller slider portions on soft Hawaiian/brioche rolls let you keep meal volume and fat load modest while dining out with a group at Cody's.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Beef or Pulled Pork Sliders plain with cheddar cheese on the soft rolls—ask for BBQ sauce, coleslaw, and crispy onions on the side or omitted.
watchOuts: Skip jalapeno poppers, buffalo wings, and raw cabbage slaw
